messages.subject: seqz-binning requiring .gz as ending of file name
parts:
sequenza-utils.py seqz-binning -s SampleX_OutSeqZ.temp

runs for a few seconds and exit with no output and no error message.

When I switch the input file name to SampleX_OutSeqZ.temp.gz

everything is fine.

Francesco, can you confirm that the ending of the input file really matters?

messages.author: dad6980b76d10753
messages.subject: Re: seqz-binning requiring .gz as ending of file name
parts:
Yes, the script trust the file name extension to open it as a gz or a plain text file or from stdin.

It is implemented in a very simple way, wrapping around python open, if the extension in .gz it uses gzip.open, if the file name is '-' it get the content from sys.stdin, otherwise just uses open...

This method is used for all the subcommands of sequenza-utils.py

Francesco
